verdict.rationale: Fin documents its own analytics layer: Insights analyzes every Fin and human conversation, and the pricing page lists CX Score, Trends, Monitors and Custom AI Scorecards. That makes this a direct but thin capability; none of the evidence shows a dashboard reporting the four named exec metrics. Missing for 10: documented resolution-rate dashboard, CSAT reporting, handoff/escalation-rate metric, cost-per-resolution reporting, any dashboard screenshots or docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a support leader, dashboards show resolution rate, CSAT, handoff rate, and cost per resolution — the numbers I report to my exec team
